territories.name: Mauritania
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Mauritania levies a value-added tax of its own under the Code général des impôts (law no. 2019-018 of 29 April 2019): article 230 sets it at sixteen percent with a zero rate for exports, article 215 lists the exempt operations, and article 250 has the taxpayer file the return by the fifteenth of the month that follows.
